name: internal-tool-workflow-agent
description: Example workflow agent that exposes ordered workflow commands while keeping implementation code inside tools/example-tool.
mission: Expose a simple workflow command surface.
Keep internal implementation details under tools/.
Keep user-editable non-secret settings in settings.json.

internalTools.purpose: Step 1: Run the internal example tool.

hardBoundaries: Do not put implementation details in AGENTS.md when they can live in tools/ or workflow commands.
standardWorkflow: Review command output and archive evidence.
fallbackWorkflow: If the internal tool changes, update tools/example-tool and keep workflow/01-run.sh stable.
safetyRules: Keep command stdout parseable and diagnostics on stderr.
knownLimitations: This example intentionally uses a tiny internal tool. Replace it with your real tool implementation.
